cv_scheme: 5-fold cross-validation; per pair, 'test_fold' is the held-out fold in which its OOF prediction was produced; the train set for that fold is all other folds.

seqclust.description: Homolog-safe split: genes clustered at >=50% sequence identity assigned whole to one fold (0 genes span >1 fold). This is the primary/deployment split.

splits_not_in_frozen_oof.note: The frozen oof_predictions.parquet stores OOF prediction columns for the gene, disease, and random splits (oof_gene_*, oof_disease_*, oof_random_*) but does NOT store their fold-index assignment columns (no fold_gene / fold_disease / fold_random). Per-fold train/test membership for those three splits is therefore not recoverable from this artifact; only fold_seqclust is stored. Regenerating them requires the split-construction code under the recorded split_lock fingerprint.
